purpose: Public-safe epistemic handoffs: places where Agalmic Research should seek missing expertise, validation or standards review instead of deepening local confidence.

handoffs.title: Formal economics of abundance shocks
handoffs.question: Can the Displaced Scarcity Hypothesis be stated as a non-trivial comparative-statics result that is not merely standard bottleneck, complementarity or induced-demand economics in new language?
handoffs.what_exists: A deep prior-art review and a deliberately narrowed verbal hypothesis; no defensible formal result yet.
handoffs.requested_contribution: Construct or adversarially review the smallest model; identify equivalent known results; specify the conditions under which scarcity, shadow values, rents or market power actually shift; recommend retirement if nothing distinct remains.
handoffs.completion_condition: Either a clearly lineage-positioned formal proposition with testable implications, or an explicit conclusion that the proposed contribution collapses into established theory.

handoffs.title: Standards review of distributed discovery provenance
handoffs.question: Which parts of a human-AI discovery episode can already be represented cleanly with W3C PROV, CRediT and RO-Crate, and which proposed Agalmic fields are genuinely missing rather than locally preferred wording?
handoffs.what_exists: An experimental standards-first profile, PROV-O-aligned JSON-LD, CRediT mappings and a historical local graph.
handoffs.requested_contribution: Review one end-to-end discovery episode representation; challenge every local extension; identify established vocabularies or profiles we should reuse; mark any actual interoperability gap.
handoffs.completion_condition: A reviewed example that can distinguish standard provenance from any narrowly justified authority/search-state extension.

handoffs.title: Measure defensibility without creating examination theatre
handoffs.question: How can human comprehension and defensibility of AI-assisted claims be assessed without collapsing into confidence ratings, rhetorical fluency or a generic viva score?
handoffs.what_exists: Working Paper 001 v0.4, prior work on verification gaps and metacognition, and a proposed separation of artefact validity, human comprehension and provenance.
handoffs.requested_contribution: Identify validated measurement approaches for transfer, error diagnosis, prediction under perturbation, calibration and reconstruction; recommend a feasible empirical protocol and its failure modes.
handoffs.completion_condition: A defensibility measurement plan grounded in existing measurement science, with explicit construct validity and anti-gaming considerations.

handoffs.title: Design a minimal epistemic-handoff pilot
handoffs.question: Can a provenance-preserving, claim-sensitive handoff improve evaluation of useful low-authority contributions without overwhelming experts or laundering authority?
handoffs.what_exists: A lineage-reviewed draft, handoff definition and extensive prior art in absorptive capacity, brokerage, intermediaries and expert-evaluation bottlenecks.
handoffs.requested_contribution: Help define a tiny pilot with a tractable number of public claims, explicit expert tasks, preserved contribution records and measurable outcomes before any platform is built.
handoffs.completion_condition: A pilot protocol small enough to run, with comparison conditions, burden measures, false-positive/false-negative considerations and stopping criteria.
